command:
set -euo pipefail; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/results/20260907-growbox-stage28e-phase-g-long-soak-v1.json > /tmp/g-soak.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,statistics,time,urllib.request
EXPECTED='389453882f0e0d2209c5bdece7eaf443895aa7ba'
d=json.load(open('/tmp/g-soak.json'))
assert d['id']=='20260907-growbox-stage28e-phase-g-long-soak-v1'
assert d['status']=='failed'
c=d['commands'][1]
out=c.get('output','')
elapsed=float(c['elapsed_seconds'])
assert 730.0 <= elapsed <= 750.0, elapsed
# The original parser failed on ESP-ROM anywhere in raw serial. Its captured result is tail-truncated;
# use final uptime vs wall elapsed to prove that reset was confined to harness startup.
body=out.rsplit('unexpected soak fault/reset ESP-ROM:esp32s3-',1)[0]
tele=[]; status=[]; main=[]; store=[]; timing=[]
for line in body.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('status firmware_sha='):
        x=dict(re.findall(r'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=([^ ]+)',line)); status.append(x)
    elif line.startswith('task name=main '): main.append(dict(re.findall(r'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=([^ ]+)',line)))
    elif line.startswith('task name=stage27_store '): store.append(dict(re.findall(r'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=([^ ]+)',line)))
    elif line.startswith('timing loop_samples='): timing.append(dict(re.findall(r'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=([^ ]+)',line)))
    if f'soak_v=2 firmware_sha={EXPECTED}' in line and 'storage_queue_drops=' in line:
        tele.append(dict(re.findall(r'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=([^ ]+)',line)))
assert len(status)>=2, len(status)
assert len(tele)>=20, len(tele)
boot_ids={x.get('boot_id') for x in status}; resets={x.get('reset_reason') for x in status}
assert len(boot_ids)==1 and None not in boot_ids and '00000000' not in boot_ids, boot_ids
assert resets=={'1'}, resets
upt=[int(x['uptime_ms']) for x in status]; assert all(b>a for a,b in zip(upt,upt[1:])), upt
final_uptime=max([int(x.get('uptime_ms','0')) for x in tele]+upt)
startup_gap_s=elapsed-final_uptime/1000.0
assert 0.0 <= startup_gap_s <= 5.0, startup_gap_s
# A later reset would make final uptime materially smaller than the 736 s wall-clock soak.
for x in status:
    assert x.get('firmware_sha')==EXPECTED and x.get('outputs')=='fake-locked' and x.get('rf_ready')=='0', x
    assert int(x['internal_free'])>=218000 and int(x['internal_min'])>=215000 and int(x['internal_largest'])>=163840, x
    assert int(x['psram_free'])>=8300000 and int(x['psram_largest'])>=8000000, x
assert len(main)>=2 and len(store)>=2 and len(timing)>=2, (len(main),len(store),len(timing))
assert {int(x.get('configured_stack_bytes','0')) for x in main}=={12288}
assert min(int(x.get('hwm_bytes','0')) for x in main)>=4096
assert {int(x.get('configured_stack_bytes','0')) for x in store}=={6144}
assert min(int(x.get('hwm_bytes','0')) for x in store)>=1536
assert all(int(x.get('loop_overruns','-1'))==0 and int(x.get('loop_max_us','1000001'))<1000000 for x in timing)
written=[]
for x in tele:
    assert x.get('firmware_sha')==EXPECTED and x.get('outputs')=='fake-locked', x
    assert x.get('ble_scanning')=='1' and x.get('scd_sample')=='1', x
    assert x.get('tp_sample')=='1' and x.get('xiaomi_sample')=='1', x
    assert int(x.get('storage_queue_drops','-1'))==0 and int(x.get('storage_write_errors','-1'))==0 and int(x.get('storage_fallbacks','-1'))==0, x
    assert all(int(x.get(k,'-1'))==0 for k in ['physical_light','physical_fan','physical_humidifier']), x
    written.append(int(x.get('storage_records_written','0')))
assert all(b>=a for a,b in zip(written,written[1:])), written
assert written[-1]>=83 and written[-1]-written[0]>=20, (written[0],written[-1])
seqs=[int(v) for v in re.findall(r'heartbeat seq=(\d+)',body)]
checks=[int(v) for v in re.findall(r'heap_integrity_ok check=(\d+)',body)]
assert seqs and max(seqs)>=72, seqs[-5:]
assert checks and max(checks)>=12, checks[-5:]
for bad in ['heap_integrity_failed','arbiter_counter_regression','Guru Meditation Error','CORRUPT HEAP','Stack canary watchpoint triggered','Task watchdog got triggered','stage28e_coredump present=1 valid=1']:
    assert bad not in body, bad
vals=[]; outputs=[]
for _ in range(5):
    with urllib.request.urlopen('http://192.168.0.16/rpc/Switch.GetStatus?id=0',timeout=5) as resp: s=json.load(resp)
    vals.append(float(s.get('apower',0.0))); outputs.append(bool(s.get('output',False))); time.sleep(0.3)
med=statistics.median(vals)
assert all(outputs) and 45.0<=med<=80.0, (outputs,vals)
last=status[-1]
print('STAGE28E_G_SOAK_REANALYSIS_IDENTITY boot_id=%s reset_reason=1 wall_s=%.3f final_uptime_ms=%d startup_reset_gap_s=%.3f'%(next(iter(boot_ids)),elapsed,final_uptime,startup_gap_s))
print('STAGE28E_G_SOAK_REANALYSIS_MEMORY free=%s min=%s largest=%s psram_free=%s psram_largest=%s'%(last['internal_free'],last['internal_min'],last['internal_largest'],last['psram_free'],last['psram_largest']))
print('STAGE28E_G_SOAK_REANALYSIS_STACK main_worst=%d store_worst=%d'%(min(int(x['hwm_bytes']) for x in main),min(int(x['hwm_bytes']) for x in store)))
print('STAGE28E_G_SOAK_REANALYSIS_RUNTIME heartbeat_seq_max=%d heap_check_max=%d tail_telemetry=%d storage_first=%d storage_last=%d loop_max_us=%s'%(max(seqs),max(checks),len(tele),written[0],written[-1],timing[-1]['loop_max_us']))
print('STAGE28E_G_SOAK_REANALYSIS_SHELLY output_all_on=1 median_apower_w=%.2f samples=%s'%(med,vals))
print('STAGE28E_G_LONG_SOAK_REANALYSIS_PASS')
print('STAGE28E_G_LONG_SOAK_SAFE_FAKE_LOCKED_PASS')
PY
